claims.statement: The Met dates settlement at Jenne-jeno to the third century BCE, with its archaeological sequence beginning around 250 BCE.
The settlement occupied the fertile Middle Niger floodplain in what is now Mali.

evidence.locator: Ancient Mali and Middle Niger Civilization; Archaeology
evidence.note: An editorial early-history window ending at 200 CE, not the end of settlement. The source continues to about 1400 CE; its later urban walls, professional districts and medieval empires are not assigned to this early window. Precise site coordinates remain unverified.
